user.title: MISO Stats
user.description:
Adds MISO grid conditions (demand, load forecast, fuel mix, renewable and carbon-free shares, estimated CO2 intensity) and a carbon intensity index from MISO's free public feeds. Polls every 15 minutes by default.

Optional: paste an API key for MISO's Emissions API (run by Singularity Energy) to get measured CO2 numbers for your own area instead of MISO-wide estimates. Create a free account at miso.singularity.energy, then copy the key from {account_url}. Leave it empty to skip; you can add it later under Configure.

singularity.title: Local emissions
singularity.description:
Your home is in {county} County, {state}: local resource zone {lrz}, balancing area {lba} ({lba_code}), {subregion} subregion.

With a key, CO2 intensity, the carbon-free and renewable shares and the Carbon Intensity Index all come from the Emissions API for the **local area** you choose here.

data_description.local_level: Hourly consumed (location-based) emissions, published about 90 minutes late. If the chosen area has no recent data, setup says so and you can pick another.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach MISO's FuelMix feed. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: The Emissions API rejected this key. Copy it again from miso.singularity.energy/account.
error.cannot_connect_singularity: Could not reach MISO's Emissions API. Try again in a few minutes.
error.outside_miso: Your home location (Settings → System → General) isn't in a MISO area the Emissions API covers.
error.level_unavailable: The Emissions API has no recent data for this area. Pick another level.

abort.single_instance_allowed: MISO Stats is already configured. Change its settings under Configure.

init.title: MISO Stats options
init.description: Polling interval, the emission factors behind the CO2 estimate, the Carbon Intensity Index settings, and the optional Emissions API key (from {account_url}).

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll MISO (5-60 minutes). MISO updates its feeds every 5 minutes.
data_description.coal_emission_factor: Grams of CO2 per kWh from coal plants (about 1,000 for the US coal fleet).
data_description.gas_emission_factor: Grams of CO2 per kWh from natural gas plants (about 400 for a combined-cycle-heavy fleet).
data_description.low_carbon_index_threshold: Low Carbon Energy Now is on when the Carbon Intensity Index is at or below this (0 = the cleanest hour of recent days, 100 = the dirtiest).
data_description.index_days: Days of history (7-30) whose cleanest and dirtiest hour set the Carbon Intensity Index's 0 and 100.
data_description.api_key: With a key, the carbon numbers come from the Emissions API for your area. Clear it to go back to MISO-wide estimates.

invalid_api_key.title: MISO Emissions API key rejected
invalid_api_key.description: MISO's Emissions API (run by Singularity Energy) no longer accepts the key MISO Stats uses, so CO2 intensity, the carbon-free and renewable shares and the index are unavailable. Copy the key again from miso.singularity.energy/account and paste it under Settings → Devices & services → MISO Stats → Configure. This message clears itself once a request succeeds.
